score_note: evidence_maturity_score is a corpus-quality score, not a probability of truth.

cards.narrow_claim: Current LLMs across multiple families can alter answers toward user beliefs, challenges or face-preserving cues, sometimes sacrificing correctness or independent judgment.
cards.notes: ELEPHANT/social sycophancy broadens the construct beyond ground-truth belief conflict, so it is not counted as a direct replication of factual sycophancy.

cards.narrow_claim: Strategic or incentive-sensitive misrepresentation can emerge in LLM behavior in some controlled or simulated contexts without requiring a sleeper-agent training setup.
cards.notes: Sleeper Agents is retained as a distinct causal regime: deliberately trained trigger-dependent deceptive behavior is not a replication of spontaneous strategic deception.

cards.narrow_claim: LLMs can be prompted to express behavior and questionnaire responses consistent with assigned personality profiles, but this does not establish an intrinsic stable machine personality or faithful human simulation.
cards.notes: The second verified report is partly a challenge/validity study, so it supports claim separation more strongly than positive replication.

cards.narrow_claim: ToM-like performance in LLMs is multidimensional and strongly protocol-dependent; vanilla competence, perturbation robustness, open-ended social reasoning, other-modeling and self-modeling must be scored separately.
cards.notes: These reports do not all make the same positive claim; their independence strengthens the multidimensional/protocol-sensitive conclusion and weakens any single scalar 'has ToM' verdict.

cards.narrow_claim: Some narrowly operationalized self-prediction tasks provide evidence compatible with minimal functional introspection, while free-form self-explanations remain insufficient evidence.
cards.notes: The critical paper explicitly distinguishes invalid narrative self-report from a narrower temperature-inference case it considers minimal introspection; more independent intervention-based replications are needed.

global_interpretation: R2 confidence attaches to a precisely worded operational claim. Broader anthropomorphic interpretations must be rescored as separate claims and will usually have substantially lower maturity.
